messages:
maya: Heads-up: multiple pages didn't go out for a subset of alerts. incidentbot showed 'delivered' but oncall didn't get SMS. :rotating_light:
incidentbot: system: POST to pagerflow returned 502 for alert 2026f; payload queued for retry; suppressor state: OFF.
alex: I'm oncall for pg-ops — I didn't get any SMS. nothing on my phone. (~12:03)
jordan: jumping in, checking notify-proxy logs now.
sam: initial look: I see a spike of 401s between 12:02-12:10 from incidentbot -> pagerflow. possible signing/key rotation mismatch.
jordan: confirm: sequence is `notify-proxy -> pagerflow-gw -> sms-relay`. logs show 502 then retries that returned 401.
maya: customer impact: a handful of customers reported delayed pages; ops flagged 2 missed escalations lasting ~12m. not P1 yet but needs triage.
ops: manual mitigation: sending manual SMS to oncall and enabling fallback path. running `tools/ops send-sms --team pg-ops --msg 'Manual page: incident 2026f'`
alex: just got the manual SMS, confirming.
sam: can we flip incidentbot to fallback mode? there's an env knob `INCIDENTBOT_PAGER_MODE=fallback` we can patch to force alternate gateway.
maya: if fallback works we should restart incidentbot to clear queued deliveries. also need to sync signing secret with pagerflow KMS.
jordan: action plan: 1) patch env to fallback (sam) 2) restart incidentbot (sam/jordan) 3) sync signing keys (security) 4) monitor 15m then revert. runbook: https://internal/runs/incident-pagerflow 
sam: patched fallback and triggered rollout: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/incidentbot -n infra`
incidentbot: system: rollout detected; 1/3 pods restarted. draining pending queue.
ops: manual SMS delivered to affected contacts. created short incident ticket INC-2026F.
alex: after restart I got paged by incidentbot fallback. ✅
maya: :tada: good. jordan — can you confirm no 502/401 in the last 5m?
jordan: monitoring: last 10m shows 200s for pagerflow and fallback route; two transient 503s at 12:11 but retries succeeded. continuing to monitor.
sam: root cause hypothesis: pagerflow signing key rotated during nightly rotation; incidentbot didn't pick up rotated key due to KMS sync lag — primary gateway returned auth errors, fallback path initially failed until we forced fallback and restarted.
ops: customer comms: drafting notice for affected early-warning customers, posting to #customer-success for review.
maya: postmortem owners: sam (code/config), jordan (ops/runbook), security (key rotation). timeline: 12:02 first failed page, 12:05 detection, 12:12 fallback patched, 12:15 normal. add pre-rotation validation step to rotation runbook.
alex: suggestion: add an alert when incidentbot marks 'delivered' but oncall hasn't acked in 5m — would detect silent deliveries.
jordan: agreed, adding a delivery->ack latency check to incidentbot metrics/evals.
maya: thanks all. we'll keep this thread open for 2h post-fix and close if stable.
sam: FYI: backup plan if rotation repeats: enable token-based auth on pagerflow and disable auto-rotate until we've validated KMS sync.
incidentbot: system: incidentbot heartbeat OK. queued: 0. posting status to #incidents.
